# Security Policy

Report a vulnerability privately through
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/ShortArrow/gitreant/security/advisories/new),
not in a public issue. Include the version (`gitreant --version`, or the
Info dialog), the OS and browser, and the steps that reproduce it.

Fixes go into the latest release only; there are no maintained older versions
before v1.0.0.

What gitreant trusts and what it is responsible for (the local server, the
repositories it reads, the git, `gh` and `gpg` commands it runs) is laid out
in [docs/QUALITY.md](../docs/QUALITY.md).
